summary.one_liner: A collection of agent skills for designers and engineers that help AI coding agents make better animation, UI design, and interface-polish decisions.
use_cases: Getting an AI agent to choose correct easing, duration and properties for UI animations
Reviewing existing animations against strict rules
Making a website feel like a native mobile app
Stress-testing UI with long names, empty lists and huge numbers
Choosing a vetted UI library instead of hand-rolled components
notable: Covers 19 named skills spanning animation, performance, gestures, mobile web polish and design review
learn-taste turns design corrections into rules saved in a DESIGN.md file for future agents
Includes Expo/React Native-specific animation guidance alongside web guidance
Includes an ask-sonner skill for the author's Sonner toast library
Based on the author's experience at Vercel and Linear
caveats: README does not describe platform limits or paid tiers
Skills are opinionated and reflect the author's personal rules and preferences
